features: Knowledge Center (Центр знаний) - Complete BCM knowledge base with AI generation
AI Article Generation - Generate articles from exercise results with verification workflow
Article Verification - Expert review for AI-generated content (pending/verified/rejected)
Full-text Search - PostgreSQL ts_rank search with relevance scoring
Bookmarking System - Save articles for later reading
Voting System - Upvote/downvote articles (usefulness score calculation)
Community Forum - Discussion topics, nested replies, voting, moderation
Reputation & Gamification - Points, 5 levels (newbie→legend), badges, leaderboards
Moderation System - Content flagging and moderation queue for specialists/admins
Scenario Marketplace (Сценарии) - Browse, filter, deploy BCM exercise scenarios
Scenario Deployment - Deploy scenarios to Validation module as exercises
Scenario Reviews - Rate and review scenarios after deployment
Forum-Knowledge Integration - Create discussions about articles
ISO 22301 Mapping - Articles and scenarios mapped to ISO clauses
Multi-tenancy - Tenant-specific and public content with RLS
Cross-Service Integration - Links to Marketplace projects and Validation exercises

Public endpoint. Sorted by created_at DESC

features: Specialist Profiles - Comprehensive profiles with skills, certifications, portfolio
Profile Verification - Admin verification for trust and quality
Profile Completion - Automatic calculation of profile completion percentage
Project Posting - Clients post BCM consulting projects
Advanced Search - Filter specialists by skills, location, rating, rate
Proposal System - Specialists submit proposals with budget and timeline
Project Lifecycle - draft → open → in_progress → completed/cancelled
Review & Rating System - Clients review specialists after project completion
Multi-dimensional Ratings - Overall, communication, quality, professionalism, timeliness
Specialist Response - Specialists can respond to reviews
Case Studies (Кейсы) - Portfolio items as case studies from completed projects
Portfolio Management - Showcase past work with deliverables, outcomes, and media
Certification Management - Add and verify professional certifications
Portal Integration - Knowledge articles and scenarios linked to marketplace
Community Reputation - Display forum reputation and badges
Project→Portal Flow - Completed projects can become Knowledge articles
EventBus Integration - Event-driven architecture for system integration
Multi-tenancy - Tenant isolation with Row Level Security
